description: Source code for the Zephyr driver for the IS31FL3733 LED controller, including register definitions, configuration, initialization, and control functions.

methods.name: is31fl3733_select_page
methods.description: Selects the target register page for the IS31FL3733 device, updating the internal selected_page state.

methods.name: is31fl3733_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specific LED by updating its PWM value.

methods.name: is31fl3733_led_on
methods.description: Turns on a specific LED by setting its brightness to maximum.

methods.name: is31fl3733_led_off
methods.description: Turns off a specific LED by setting its brightness to zero.

methods.name: is31fl3733_led_write_channels
methods.description: Writes PWM values to multiple LED channels starting from a specified channel.

methods.name: is31fl3733_init
methods.description: Initializes the IS31FL3733 device, configuring registers and setting initial states.

methods.name: is31fl3733_blank
methods.description: Enables or disables the LED display for power saving or flicker-free updates.

methods.name: is31fl3733_current_limit
methods.description: Sets the global current limit for the LED driver.
